paite: Huan, hichi ahia, huai thilte nungin Pathianin Abraham a zeeta, a kiangah, Abraham, achia; huan, aman, Hiaiah ka om hi, achia.
english: It happened after these things, that God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Huan, aman, Na tapa, na tapa neih sun, na ittak, Isaak mah, pi inla, Moria gamah pai inla, huai ah kon hilh ding tang khat ah halmanga pumpiakna a dingin lanin, achia.
english: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, whom you love, even Isaac, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there for a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

paite: Huan, Abraham bel takin a thoua, sabengtung a bawla, a kiangah sikha tangval nih a pia, a tapa Isaak toh, huan, halmanga pumpiakna a dingin sing a eka, a thoua, Pathianin a hilhna mun lamah a paita hi.
english: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.

paite: Huan, ni thum niin Abraham a daka, a mun gamla piah a mu a.
english: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

paite: Huchiin, Abrahamin a sikha Tangvalte kiangah, hiaiah sabengtung toh na om unla, kei leh naupang hua pamah ka vahoh ding ua; huan, Pathian ka vebe ding ua, na kiang uah ka hong kik nawn ding uh, achia.
english: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go yonder. We will worship, and come back to you.”

paite: Huan, Abrahamin halmanga pumpiakna sing a laa a tapa Isaak a posaka; aman mei leh temta a tawia; huchiin a nih un a pai khawmta uh.
english: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.

paite: Huan, Isaakin a pa Abraham a houpiha, Pa, achia; huan, aman, bawi, hiaiah ka om, achia. Huan, aman endih, mei leh sing lah a oma; hileleng halmanga pumpiakna ding belamnou lah koiah? achia.
english: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”

paite: Huan, Abrahamin, bawi, Pathianin amah adinga halmanga pumpiakna ding belamnou a ngaihtuah tawm nakeh, achia: huchiin a nih un a pai khawm jel uh.
english: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.

paite: Huan, Pathianin a hilhna mun a vatungta uh; huan, Abrahamin huailaiah maitam a doha, sing achiang khawma, a tapa Isaak a gaka, maitama sing tungah a lumsaka
english: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

paite: Huan, Abrahamin a khut a lika, a tapa thahna dingin temta a laa.
english: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.

paite: Huan, Toupa angelin van akipanin amah a samta. Abraham, Abraham, achia: huan, aman, hiaiah ka om, achia.
english: The angel of Yahweh called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Huan, aman, naupang tungah na khut kha ken, amah bangmah chih sam ken: na tapa, na neihsun mahmah leng na it louh jiakin Pathian na kihta chih tuin ka theita ahi, achia.
english: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy, neither do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”

paite: Huan, Abraham a daka, a ena, huan, ngaiin, a nunglamah belampa a ki a singbawka awk a na om a oma: huchiin, Abrahamin belampa a vamana, huai a tapa sikin halmanga pumpiakna dingin a lan zotaa.
english: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

paite: Huchiin, Abrahamin huai lai mun min dingin Jehova-jire a saa: tuni tanin, Toupa tangah ngaihtuah hina ve, a chih jel bangun.
english: Abraham called the name of that place Yahweh Will Provide or, Yahweh-Jireh, or, Yahweh-Seeing . As it is said to this day, “On Yahweh’s mountain, it will be provided.”

paite: Huan, Toupa angelin a nihveina dingin van akipanin Abraham a sam nawna.
english: The angel of Yahweh called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,

paite: Hiai thil na hih jiak leh na ta neih sun na it louh jiakin; kei mahmahin ka kichiam, Toupan a chi:
english: and said, “I have sworn by myself, says Yahweh, because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,

paite: Ka honvualjawl ngeingei dinga, vana aksi zah leh tuipi piaua piaunel zahin na suante ka pungsak ngeingei ding; na suanten a doute uh kulh kongkhak a neihsak ding uh;
english: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your seed greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your seed will possess the gate of his enemies.

paite: Ka thu na man jiakin na suan ah khovel a chi chih a na vak ding uh, chiin,
english: In your seed will all the nations of the earth be blessed, because you have obeyed my voice.”

paite: Huchiin Abraham sikha Tangvalte kiangah akik nawna, huan, a thou ua, Beer-seba ah a om nilouh uhi.
english: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.

paite: Huan, hichi ahia, huai thilte nungin, mi’n Abraham kiangah, Ngaiin, Milkain leng na nau Nahor tate a neihsakta ve, chiin, a hilh ua;
english: It happened after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

paite: A ta masa Uz ahi a; a nau Buz ahi a, Kemuel Aram pa toh;
english: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

paite: Chesedte, Hazo, Pildaste, Jidlapte, Bethuelte leng ahi uh.
english: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”

paite: Huan, Bethuelin tanu Rebeka a neia; huai giatte Milkain Abraham nau Nahor a neihsak ahi.A mei, a min Reumain leng Tebahte, Gahamte, Tahaste, Maakte leng a nei hi.
english: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

paite: A mei, a min Reumain leng Tebahte, Gahamte, Tahaste, Maakte leng a nei hi.
english: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
